title: PlanGenerated
description: Immutable event emitted by the router after LLM plan generation. Topic: conversation-events. Producer: routerService.ts. Consumer: orchestrator.ts.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation (partition key)

sessionId.description: WebSocket session identifier for routing the final answer back

steps.description: Ordered list of tool invocation steps

tool.description: Name of the tool to invoke

args.description: Arguments for the tool; values may contain {{step_N.result}} placeholders
